newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - SocGen raises BPB to "hold".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SocGen raises BPB to "hold".

text.p: Brokerage SocGen said on Thursday it had raised BPB Plc to "hold" from "sell", although it downgraded its 1997 profit forecast.

The worldwide growth in plasterboard demand continued to underpin BPB, SocGen said in a research study. In particular, the prospective growth for plasterboard in developing countries would make the British building materials group attractive in the long term, it said.

But the weakness in the European paper industry combined with ongoing fears over plasterboard prices would cast a shadow in the short term, SocGen said, adding it had downgraded its pre-tax profit forecast for 1997 to 174.8 million stg from 185 .
By 1255 GMT the stock was down 1-1/2p to 333-1/2p.
Earlier on Thursday BPB reported a rise in pre-tax profit to 189.1 million stg from 161.4 million.
